issues.description: Constructor parameter order is inconsistent between the UML (which the problem statement says to follow) and the reference solution. The UML lists attributes in the order: numberOfInscribedStudents, lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfTutors, implying a constructor in that order. The solution implements `Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors)`. Students following the UML order may implement a different constructor signature than expected by tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UML attribute order match the intended constructor signature (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), or change the required constructor (and tests/solution) to follow the UML order consistently.
